Price this schedule

01–03 Wash · Scrape · Prime

01 WASH dry to touch: n/a

Washed, scraped, sanded and spot-primed before two full coats, so the new paint has something to hold.

02 SCRAPE dry to touch: n/a

Pre-1978 houses prepped with plastic, wet scraping and careful cleanup around kids, pets and gardens.

03 PRIME dry to touch: 2–4 h

Spot primer on bare wood and stains so the top coat bonds and hides what was underneath.

Homes built before 1978 may contain lead-based paint. We test first, use plastic containment, wet scraping and HEPA cleanup when needed.

Brick rowhouses with porches in Richmond's Fan district
